$comment: CYP-159 Klasse C — ProjectSwitcher dropdown hint width bound. docs-only. Grounded @ develop d57dccb.

SWITCHER_HINT_MAX_WIDTH.rule: Modifier.widthIn(max = SWITCHER_HINT_MAX_WIDTH) on the TonedHint inside the DropdownMenu => text wraps instead of clipping off the right screen edge
SWITCHER_HINT_MAX_WIDTH.rationale: A long single-line hint widens the DropdownMenu past the screen edge on a 411dp phone. Bounding the width makes it wrap. 280dp keeps the menu comfortably on-screen; calibrate against the longest localized hint (DE/EN).

secondary.$comment: Long project names should also be bounded so they don't widen the menu.
secondary.menuItemLabels: maxLines = 1 + TextOverflow.Ellipsis on DropdownMenuItem project-name Text (mirrors the active-row at Z.72-73)
